   209→class AttributeDict(UserDict):
   210→    def __init__(self, __dict: None = None) -> None:
   211→        super().__init__(__dict)
   212→        self.data: dict[str, str] = {}
   213→
   214→    def __getitem__(self, key: str) -> str:
   215→        possible_items = {}
   216→        for k, v in self.data.items():
   217→            if re.fullmatch(k, key) or k == key:
   218→                possible_items[k] = v
   219→        if not possible_items:
   220→            raise KeyError(key)
   221→        longest_match = sorted(possible_items.keys(), key=len)[-1]
   222→        return possible_items[longest_match]
   223→
   224→    def get(self, key: str, default: Any = None) -> Any:
   225→        try:
   226→            return self.__getitem__(key)
   227→        except KeyError:
   228→            return default
   229→
   230→    def __repr__(self) -> str:
   231→        keys = []
   232→        for k in self.data.keys():
   233→            keys.append(k.replace("\\", ""))
   234→        return f"{keys!r}"

   249→                    f"/properties/{name}"
   250→                )
   251→
   252→        if schema.type_name == "AWS::CloudFormation::Stack":
   253→            self._attrs["Outputs\\..*"] = "/properties/CfnLintStringType"
   254→            return
   255→
   256→        for unnamed_type in _unnamed_unknown_types:
   257→            if schema.type_name.startswith(unnamed_type):
   258→                self._attrs[".*"] = "/properties/CfnLintAllTypes"
   259→
   260→        for ro_attr in schema.schema.get("readOnlyProperties", []):
   261→            self._attrs[self._pointer_to_attr(ro_attr)] = ro_attr
   262→
   263→    def _pointer_to_attr(self, pointer: str) -> str:
   264→        return ".".join(pointer.split("/")[2:])
   265→
   266→    def _process_schema(self, obj: dict[str, Any], schema: "Schema", path: str):
   267→        types = ensure_list(obj.get("type"))
   268→        if "object" in types:
   269→            for prop, value in obj.get("properties", {}).items():
   270→                self._process_schema(value, schema, f"{path}/{prop}")
   271→        elif "array" in types:
   272→            # GetAtt doesn't support going into an array of objects or another array
   273→            # so we only look at an array of strings, etc.
   274→            if obj.get("items", {}).get("type") in ["object", "array"]:
   275→                return
   276→            self._attrs[self._pointer_to_attr(path)] = path
   277→        elif obj.get("$ref"):
   278→            _, obj = schema.resolver.resolve(obj.get("$ref"))
   279→            self._process_schema(obj, schema, path)
   280→        else:
   281→            self._attrs[self._pointer_to_attr(path)] = path

    13→class GetAttFormat(CfnLintKeyword):

    15→    shortdesc = "Check if GetAtt matches destination format"
    16→    description = (
    17→        "Validate that if source and destination format exists that they match"
    18→    )
    19→    source_url = "https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSCloudFormation/latest/UserGuide/best-practices.html#parmtypes"
    20→    tags = ["parameters", "ec2", "imageid"]

    23→        super().__init__(["*"])
    24→        self.parent_rules = ["E1010"]

    27→            "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup.GroupId",
    28→            "AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup.GroupIds",
    29→        ]
    30→        self._resource_type_exceptions = [
    31→            "AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource",
    32→            "AWS::CloudFormation::Stack",
    33→        ]
    34→
    35→    def validate(
    36→        self, validator: Validator, _, instance: Any, schema: Any
    37→    ) -> ValidationResult:
    38→        fmt = schema.get("format")
    39→        if not fmt or fmt in self._exceptions:
    40→            return
    41→
    42→        resource, attr = instance[0:2]
    43→
    44→        getatt_ptr = validator.context.resources[resource].get_atts[attr]
    45→        t = validator.context.resources[resource].type
    46→
    47→        if t in self._resource_type_exceptions:
    48→            return
    49→
    50→        for (
    51→            _,
    52→            resource_schema,
    53→        ) in PROVIDER_SCHEMA_MANAGER.get_resource_schemas_by_regions(
    54→            t, validator.context.regions
    55→        ):
    56→            getatt_schema = resource_schema.resolver.resolve_cfn_pointer(getatt_ptr)
    57→            getatt_fmt = getatt_schema.get("format")
    58→            if getatt_fmt != fmt:
    59→                yield ValidationError(
    60→                    f"{{'Fn::GetAtt': {instance!r}}} that does not match {fmt!r}",
    61→                    rule=self,
    62→                )
